    contains 851631: Hair-dressing apparatus; electro-thermic hair dryers
    contains 851632: Hair-dressing apparatus; electro-thermic, other than hair dryers

    contains 851679: Electro-thermic appliances; n.e.c. in heading no. 8516, used for domestic purposes

data.reason: An electric hair dryer is an electro-thermic hair-dressing apparatus, covered by heading 8516 (subheading 851631), not by 8510, which covers shavers, clippers and hair-removing appliances.
